supersedes: the 2M figure carried forward from the EXP2 compression budget, which was inherited rather than scientifically required for SPPPO
rule: ONE 1M-step production run, terminal checkpoint only, NO extension
the_1M_terminal_owns_the_verdict: if the result is disliked, the run is NOT quietly continued to 2M. Freezing 1M prospectively makes 1M scientifically legitimate; extending it after seeing the outcome would not be.
why_1M_is_the_better_first_budget: SPPPO starts from strong frozen SAPPO teachers, so it is not learning strategy from scratch
the payoff-ranking signal is meant to provide MORE TARGETED supervision, not to require twice the brute-force PPO
a 1M run gives a cleaner test of whether the METHOD helps, rather than whether more compute helps
the scorer/branching phase is already expensive; this keeps the total tractable
frozen prospectively, so there is no scientific objection to the smaller budget
does_not_change_phase_0: Phase 0 remains exactly as frozen: it determines only whether the strategic scorer is good enough to justify SPPPO at all. Its block, allocation, split, branch count and gates are untouched.
sequence: if YES: freeze SPPPO protocol with TOTAL BUDGET = 1M
unchanged_from_the_earlier_sketch: the strategic ranking objective as the only substantive new ingredient
